name: Magic Kingdom Theme Park
description: The quintessential Disney park with Cinderella Castle, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Peter Pan's Flight, and nighttime fireworks spectacle.
tips: Book Lightning Lane early and take a mid-day resort break for young children.

name: Universal's Islands of Adventure & Harry Potter
description: Experience Hogwarts Castle in Hogsmeade, Hagrid's Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure, and Jurassic World VelociCoaster.
tips: Get a park-to-park ticket to ride the Hogwarts Express between Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure.

name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
description: Stand under the real Space Shuttle Atlantis, touch a moon rock, meet a veteran astronaut, and experience the Shuttle Launch Simulator.
tips: Check the launch calendar before visiting to see if a real rocket launch coincides with your trip.

name: Wekiwa Springs State Park & Kayaking
description: Pristine natural 72-degree crystal freshwater spring pool perfect for swimming, paddle boarding, canoeing, and spotting Florida turtles and birds.
tips: Arrive before 9:00 AM on weekends as the park reaches capacity early.

name: San Diego Zoo & Panda Ridge
description: World-famous 100-acre botanical zoo housing giant pandas, polar bears, elephants, gorillas, and a complimentary guided double-decker bus tour.
tips: Ride the Skyfari aerial tram from one end of the park to the other for panoramic views.

name: La Jolla Cove & Sea Lion Colony
description: Watch wild sea lions and harbor seals basking on the rocks, explore shallow tide pools, and enjoy world-class Pacific sunset ocean views.
tips: Bring water shoes for exploring the tidal pools safely at low tide.

name: USS Midway Aircraft Carrier Museum
description: Walk the flight deck of America's longest-serving aircraft carrier, climb into fighter jet cockpits, and hear audio tours narrated by real navy pilots.
tips: Kids can participate in the Junior Pilot audio adventure and receive a real set of wings.

name: Old Faithful & Upper Geyser Basin Boardwalk
description: Watch the predictable eruption of Old Faithful shooting boiling water 140 feet high, then stroll the wooden boardwalks past Morning Glory Pool.
tips: Check the visitor center for exact eruption prediction times accurate to within 10 minutes.

name: Lamar Valley Wildlife Safari Drive
description: Known as the 'Serengeti of North America', Lamar Valley offers extraordinary roadside views of thousands of wild bison, elk, pronghorn, and bears.
tips: Bring binoculars or a spotting scope for spotting wolf packs in the foothills.

name: Natural History & Science Museum (South Kensington)
description: Iconic cathedral-like museum with an animatronic T-Rex, blue whale skeleton (Hope), earthquake simulator, and Wonderlab interactive science gallery.
tips: General admission is 100% free; book free timed entry tickets online to skip queues.

name: Tower of London & Crown Jewels
description: Explore 1,000 years of royal intrigue, see the priceless sparkling Crown Jewels, see the resident ravens, and join a lively Yeoman Warder (Beefeater) tour.
tips: Head straight to the Crown Jewels building upon opening to view them without waiting in long queues.

name: Tokyo DisneySea
description: Considered by many the best theme park in the world, featuring 7 nautical themed ports, Mount Prometheus volcano, Journey to the Center of the Earth, and Fantasy Springs.
tips: Download the Tokyo Disney Resort app in advance to reserve Premier Access and Standby passes.

name: teamLab Planets TOKYO (Toyosu)
description: Wade barefoot through knee-deep digital water filled with glowing projected koi fish, wander infinity crystal rooms, and touch floating floral spheres.
tips: Wear pants that can be easily rolled above the knees since you will be walking in water.

name: Mistico Arenal Hanging Bridges & Sloth Walk
description: Walk through 2 miles of primary rainforest canopy crossing 16 suspension bridges with volcano views and guided wildlife spotting for monkeys, sloths, and poison dart frogs.
tips: Hire an on-site naturalist guide who brings a spotting telescope to reveal hidden rainforest animals.

name: Baldi Hot Springs Natural Thermal Water Park
description: 30 distinct thermal pools heated naturally by the Arenal Volcano, surrounded by cascading waterfalls, tropical gardens, and a dedicated kids' water slide area.
tips: Day passes often include an optional buffet dinner inside the resort.

name: Xcaret Eco-Archaeological Park
description: Float down underground Mayan rivers with lifejackets, visit the coral reef aquarium and sea turtle pavilion, and watch the legendary 'Xcaret México Espectacular' evening show.
tips: Life jackets and lockers are included; bring water-friendly sandals with backstraps.

name: Molokini Crater Catamaran & Sea Turtle Snorkel
description: Sail out to a sunken volcanic crater with 150-foot water visibility, hundreds of tropical fish species, and a second stop at Turtle Town to swim alongside Hawaiian green sea turtles.
tips: Most charters provide flotation belts and prescription optical snorkel masks for kids and adults.

name: National Air and Space Museum & Planetarium
description: Walk under Neil Armstrong's spacesuit, see the original 1903 Wright Brothers Flyer, touch a piece of the Moon, and explore interactive aviation exhibits.
tips: Reserve free online timed passes on the Smithsonian website in advance.

name: Smithsonian National Zoo & Giant Panda Pavilion
description: Sprawling historic zoological park home to giant pandas, Asian elephants, cheetahs, and the Amazonia indoor rainforest.
tips: Start at the top of the hill (Connecticut Ave entrance) and walk downhill through the exhibits.
